_comment: The prompt in use for each kind, and the sha256 of every version's file. A version is never edited: a changed prompt is a new file and a new version (tests/test_export_genai.py holds this).

history.scouting-v3: Dropped rule 6 of scouting-v2 (call the descriptive values descriptive) to cut sentences that read above grade 9. The prep page now says it in a fixed note (web/content/site.json, machineText.descriptive). The next scouting prompt must restore the rule in plain words (ml-review of p3-v3).
history.scouting-v4: Aimed at the D93 failures: fixed sentence frames for whose value it is (his made shots above expected never have the model as subject), sign words that follow the sign of the defender distance, one value per sentence with its range, no invented counts, and rule 6 of scouting-v2 restored as a fixed sentence (the numbers about defenders, rebounds, absences and style describe his past games). Every frame passes the checks of export/genai.py and reads at grade 9 or lower.
